newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, eye 21,000 barrier.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, eye 21,000 barrier.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended sharply higher in technically-driven trade on Thursday and dealers said the market looked set to test the psychological resistance level of 21,000 points.
"There was no news behind the move. It was just technicals," said a Japanese bank dealer. "We hit the magical number of 20,800 and people just started buying it up."
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended 310 points higher at 20,940 on turnover of 21,500 lots. March was at 20,970 on 8,150 lots.

Dealers said the market shrugged off an early news report quoting a former senior Japanese Finance Ministry official who said the Bank of Japan wanted to make an upward correction to the 0.5 percent official discount rate.
"The next target is the 21,000 psychological resistance. And after that 21,300 will be the big one," said the dealer.
